items.name: LUXE D-Tan Mask
items.description: Reveal clearer, brighter skin with the TVFM Luxe D-Tan Mask, a powerful salon-grade treatment formulated to reduce tan, detoxify, and restore your skin's natural radiance. Its rich, creamy texture helps draw out impurities, reduce pigmentation, and even out skin tone, leaving the skin refreshed, smooth, and glowing. Ideal for regular salon treatments or at-home skincare routines, it provides instant rejuvenation and long-lasting brightness.
